description: An adaptive text field for Uno Platform built to the Control Gallery prototype: it reads what you type as a date (with an optional time), a #colour, an @person or a #tag, shows a dashed suggestion with a Tab key in the field and a matching fixed-height picker under it (quick picks and a month, a swatch with HEX and RGB, people or tag rows), turns an accepted value into a token that Backspace in the empty field reverts, keeps text on Esc, says when text that starts like a date does not read as one, and on phones moves the suggestions into a bar above the keyboard. DM Sans and DM Mono are bundled; the palette is the prototype's near-black with a pink accent, with a derived Light theme and an in-app switch.

messages.content:
Bring my adaptive input in line with the Control Gallery prototype:
- recognise dates (with times), #colours, @people and #tags
- Tab or click accepts the suggestion, Esc keeps the text, Backspace in the empty field restores it
- the picker anchored under the field at a fixed height: quick picks and a month, a colour swatch with HEX and RGB, people and tag rows
- text that starts like a date but isn't one stays text and offers the picker
- on a phone, suggestions ride above the keyboard
- the prototype's DM Sans / DM Mono type and near-black palette with a pink accent; keep a Light theme

The **Adaptive Input** now follows the prototype: dates, colours, people and tags with a Tab suggestion and a fixed-height picker, tokens with Backspace undo, a Not recognised state for date-like text, and a suggestion bar on phones, in DM Sans and DM Mono on the prototype's dark palette.

Remember the chosen theme between launches

messages.content: This is the Adaptive Input sample: a text field that recognises dates, colours, people and tags, built to the Control Gallery prototype.

Adaptive Input is one Uno single project, `AdaptiveInputDemo/AdaptiveInputDemo.csproj` (Uno.Sdk 7.0.22 from `global.json`; heads net10.0-android, net10.0-browserwasm and net10.0-desktop; UnoFeatures Material, Toolkit, SkiaRenderer). No MVVM or Navigation: `App.xaml.cs` navigates a Frame to `Presentation/MainPage`, applies Dark once at startup with `SystemThemeHelper` and keeps the frame in `App.ThemeRoot`.

**Key files:**
- `Controls/AdaptiveInput/AdaptiveInputControl.cs`: templated Control. DPs Value, Header, Placeholder, People (IList<AdaptivePerson>), Tags (IList<AdaptiveTag>), ReferenceDate, SuggestionsPlacement (Panel/Accessory), IsPickerOpen; read-only State (AdaptiveInputState Empty/Recognised/Plain/NotRecognised/Accepted), DetectedType, AcceptedToken and the display values the template binds (SuggestionText, StatusText, TokenText, AcceptedTitle, MonthTitle, TimeNote, HexText, RgbText, SwatchBrush, Days, QuickPicks, Rows, AccessoryItems, NoMatchText); methods Accept, Dismiss, Undo, Clear, FocusField; events TokenAccepted, Submitted. Keys on the TextBox's PreviewKeyDown (Tab, Esc, Back with a deferred Undo, Enter, Up/Down). Update() recomputes everything and sets visual states (FieldStates, InputStates, PanelStates, SuggestionStates, SuggestionKindStates, TokenStates, MatchStates, PlacementStates).
- `Controls/AdaptiveInput/AdaptiveInputModels.cs`: AdaptiveInputState, SuggestionsPlacement, AdaptiveToken, AdaptivePerson, AdaptiveTag, AdaptiveChoice (row/day/chip view model with a Pick command), RelayCommand.
- `Controls/AdaptiveInput/AdaptiveInputControl.xaml`: the default style and template (field, status, 300 px picker with date/colour/rows/plain/not-recognised/accepted views, accessory bar with an ItemsRepeater), part styles (chip, row, day, ghost, outline, dashed suggestion, bare TextBox), data templates bound with {Binding}, tokens (placeholder, avatar, swatch edge per theme; DM Mono family; sizes).
- `Services/InputTypeDetector.cs`: static Detect(text, today), LooksLikeDate, ParseDate, FormatDate, ExpandHex, ToColor.
- `Presentation/MainPage.xaml(.cs)`: the control and the example list; `{utu:Responsive}` switches to the phone layout below 600 px and shows the examples from 1080 px; an IconToggleButton is the theme switch.
- `Styles/ColorPaletteOverride.xaml` (Dark = prototype, Light derived), `Styles/MaterialFontsOverride.xaml` (DefaultFontFamily = DM Sans with a weight manifest). Licences in `Assets/Fonts/OFL-*.txt`.
- `HotDesignPreviews/` (Debug only): InputEmpty, InputDate, InputDateTime, InputColor, InputMention, InputTag, InputPlain, InputNotRecognised, InputAccepted, InputAccessory previews, each setting ReferenceDate to 2026-11-25.

**Build:** `dotnet build AdaptiveInputDemo/AdaptiveInputDemo.csproj -f net10.0-desktop`.

The app is built and running. The user may ask me to modify it.
